liveProvider.note: The retained production-canary audit passes 3/3 across UX and music theory. The exact-weight Qwen challenger produced a separate 12-lesson 99/A package with zero P0/P1, while the current branded public route remains the keyless Pollinations-backed Scion path.

manualHuman.note: No independent instructor review, new-weight claim, or general model-superiority claim is made. Offline review packets are ready, but the approved instructor count remains zero.

claims.summary: The public configuration presents one product identity: Provider Scion, a disabled no-key API field, and the versioned Scion V0.16.3 model. The description is concise, while technical provider and model provenance remains in code, diagnostics, and evidence artifacts.

claims.summary: The landing and setup flow is brief-first, guided by Brief, Materials, and Generate, supplies a recommended package, explains blocked and ready actions, collapses optional tuning, preserves sticky mobile handoffs, and raises touch targets without claiming the mobile workspace table is solved.

Compiler-distributed assessment priority favors richer performance artifacts, fully explicit source weights remain authoritative, and lesson-seeded FAQ, lesson-plan, slide, and short-answer variants reduce repeated phrase families while preserving evidence-bounded assessment contracts.

Source-backed music and UX kernels survive the live compiler and export path. Retained runs demonstrate 28 verified music MC seats, a 12-lesson 99/A UX package with zero P0/P1 and 101 files, and a passing 3/3 production-canary aggregate across two domains.

The matched UX matrix reports both strengths and gaps: Scion ties Luna's applied-item count but trails its rate, matches inference, answer alignment, scenario coverage, and materials, and leads the retained pair on rationale contrast, decision readiness, and cue-free claim-evidence-boundary answers without making a general superiority claim.

All 411 unverified preference rows remain quarantined under an explicit evidence-kind allowlist. The five-domain blind packet supplies offline zero-network reviewer pages and packet-bound forms, while ingestion requires exact packet identity, independent domain-qualified reviewers, no conflict, high factual and teachability scores, and contract-clean winning atoms.

A registered exact-provenance protocol separates repeated factual screening from promotion. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 4B tie on two cold and two source-grounded screens; Qwen adds one exact-weight 12-lesson 99/A UX run but remains unpromoted pending four more domains, browser classes, matched controls, and independent instructor evidence.
proofCommands: npx vitest run tests/scion-model-bakeoff.test.js tests/crucible-browser-freshness.test.js tests/local-provider.test.js

claims.summary: The model bakeoff also audits Scion itself. It measures call amplification and rejected repair actions, attributes future subcalls by schema, gates promotion above 1.25x matched-control amplification, avoids unnecessary applied-depth rewrites, hardens the prompt against answer leakage, preserves native SSE and heartbeats, drains loader stderr, clears timed-out starts, records exact source weights, and keeps all 40 compiler contracts deterministic as retained evidence grows.
